open_decision: Whether a release by the lock owner must work: the laws never require that a release takes the owner out of the critical section.
result_a: Design A (Exp.lock, isOwner is exact match) is not in the critical section after the release.
result_b: Design B (same as Exp.lock but isOwner always returns false, so release does nothing) is still in the critical section.
reason: Law 1 to 3 only restrict acquire, exit and non-release events, and they say nothing about a successful release. Design B keeps the owner record and the process in the critical section forever, so it passes every law (mutex, no orphan hold, holder keeps lock, can refuse, can enter) but differs from Design A after the release.
